description: The HUD window, which loads jarvis_hud.html — a page vendored byte-identical from the backend folder and therefore not written against this app's IPC surface. It gets NO app commands at all. The shell talks to it one way, by evaluating a call to a feed the initialisation script defines, so nothing here needs to be granted for the HUD to work; and the next drop of that file cannot arrive holding a permission it was never audited for. There is deliberately no `remote` block anywhere: every window loads a bundled page.
